items: Re-reviews continue their previous reviewer session when available; the gate shows why a fresh review is needed.
The publication gate can accept open review findings with a written reason.
Evidence opens in a full-screen review with criterion clips, proof details, zoom and shareable links.
Run files have a searchable browser and preview, and the workspace keeps its last snapshot while reconnecting.
Gate decisions wait for the gateway and reconcile a lost or late reply before offering another action.
